Hook: Your coding agent says it's done. A real browser says otherwise.
Approve: Describe the goal. Contexer turns it into checks, and you approve them.
Build: Your coding agent builds it. Its own report never counts as a pass.
Prove: Contexer runs every check in Chromium against your running app.
PullRequest: You review a pull request with the proof inside.
Issues: Or label a GitHub issue and approve its checks in one comment.
Numbers: Measured on 7 apps with 40 seeded bugs.
Cta: Free with an OpenRouter key. Open source under MIT.
